summary: The change sets LimitNOFILE=4096 in all three native service templates, documents a 1,536-descriptor planning budget, adds tools/check-open-files.py whose fixture checks the inherited soft/hard limit and holds 500 client/upstream stream pairs plus queued and idle links, and adds a default-limit saturation regression that checks the 503 local_inference_overload response. No actionable defect was found in the changed paths; the measure.py tailing fix is a legitimate partial-line repair and its tests cover the new EOF handling.

evidence: cpp/gateway/ops/uos-gateway-native.service, cpp/gateway/ops/uos-gateway-native-no-landlock.service and cpp/gateway/ops/side-by-side/uos-gateway-side-by-side.service.in each set LimitNOFILE=4096, and ops/README.md documents the budget: 1,024 active sockets plus 128 waiting clients plus 128 idle upstreams plus 256 runtime equals 1,536 planned with 2,560 headroom.

cpp/gateway/tools/check-open-files.py --check validates the 512/128 admission defaults, the 64-per-scheme idle pool and each unit's limit; --fixture requires the effective soft/hard limits to be 4096 and holds 500 client/upstream stream pairs (STREAMS=500) plus 128 waiting links, 128 idle links and 256 reserve descriptors, failing the unit on any open or socket error.

cpp/gateway/ops/README.md documents installing a rendered template as a disposable test unit and asserting LimitNOFILESoft, LimitNOFILE, Result and the fixture PASS output, and it explicitly avoids production activation.

cpp/gateway/tests/handler_admission_differential_test.cpp adds a default-limit saturation case that holds 512 permits and 128 waiters and verifies HTTP 503 with retry-after 5 and error.code local_inference_overload from the ordinary response builder.
